whatChangedAndWhy: Tree's own approval path worked unattended for the first time — today's run drafted a pair, dispatched social-tree-approve.yml and both items are on main with a valid tree:auto stamp, no founder tick anywhere. What is broken is merging: one stale allowlist line in scripts/lib/moment-media-gate.mjs turns build-content red on every Tree PR, so the Runway hero (#5998), the founder-approved Blank Spaces hero (#6056) and both inbox-expiry PRs are stuck and nothing posted between 10-15 and 10-19. Two strategy changes, made and reported in PR #6105: Experiment 01 (Instagram hashtags) read out at n=2 with both arms at IG reach 1 and every October IG post at reach 0-1, so it is closed as unreadable — tags become the default on every IG beat, the arms go away, and the comparison returns only when trailing-7-day median reach clears 10; and a thread hero whose window closed because CI was red now gets one make-good inside the same month, which is why Runway finally gets taught on 10-30. No new experiment this fortnight on purpose: nothing on-platform is measurable at reach 1. No lessons changed (zero edits and zero rejections this week, 6 of 6 approved) and no founder task filed — the week's one real blocker is a one-line script fix, which is Marjorie's, not the owner's.
